intent: Trace all catalogued capabilities to a Reaper-owned implementation layer without changing source-registry status or claiming unimplemented native support.

status_policy.catalog_membership: A specification record is not an implementation.
status_policy.rpr_library: Pure or bounded algorithms that can be implemented with current Reaper syntax belong in .rpr modules.
status_policy.compiler_frontend: Syntax, static typing, ownership, effects, canonical AST/IR, optimization and code generation require language/compiler implementation and differential tests.
status_policy.native_runtime: Memory, concurrency, atomics, pointer layouts and deterministic resource primitives require a real Reaper runtime/backend contract.
status_policy.host_adapter: Filesystem, network, process, clock, device and privileged operations require explicit opt-in host capabilities; source code cannot grant authority.
status_policy.security: Cryptographic claims and isolation require reviewed primitives and platform evidence; metadata validation is not cryptographic verification.
